Trump signals he is ready to escalate tariffs on Asian trading partners

President Trump sent a message to trading partners across Asia that he is ready to escalate tariffs. Many of those partners depend on trade and investment from both the United States and China. The latest tariffs revive the focus on pressuring China.

Reported by The New York Times; Axios; BBC; CNBC. Written by AI.
